label: Manali, Himachal Pradesh
tagline: Snow peaks, pine forests and the Beas river.

hotels.name: Zostel Manali
hotels.note: Mountain hostel above the river with a bonfire deck and dorm beds.

hotels.name: Himalayan Cottage
hotels.note: Family-run rooms near the hot springs; simple home-cooked meals.

hotels.name: Sunshine Himalayan Resort
hotels.note: Cottages with balconies facing the deodar forest; open lawn.

hotels.name: Manuallaya Resort & Spa
hotels.note: Colonial-style resort set in apple orchards with a spa.

hotels.name: The Himalayan
hotels.note: Castle-style hotel with panoramic valley views and a famous coffee shop.

hotels.name: Span Resort & Spa
hotels.note: Riverside resort with trout fishing and cottages among the pines.

things_to_do.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
things_to_do.note: Cedar-wood temple from 1553 set in a grove of giant deodars.

things_to_do.name: Solang Valley
things_to_do.note: Paragliding and zorbing in summer; the nearest slopes for snow play.

things_to_do.name: Old Manali cafe walk
things_to_do.note: Lanes of cafes and craft shops above the Manalsu river.

things_to_do.name: Vashisht hot springs
things_to_do.note: Natural sulphur springs with separate bathing areas; free to use.

things_to_do.name: Atal Tunnel to Sissu
things_to_do.note: Drive the 9 km tunnel under the Rohtang pass to the cold desert beyond.

eateries.name: Johnson's Cafe
eateries.must_try: Trout, wood-fired pizza and apple crumble
eateries.note: Garden restaurant in a 1920s English cottage; a Manali institution.

eateries.name: Drifters' Cafe
eateries.note: Relaxed riverside terrace, popular for breakfast and live music.

eateries.name: Casa Bella Vista
eateries.note: Italian menu on a hanging terrace looking over the valley.

eateries.name: Chopsticks
eateries.note: Long-running Tibetan and Chinese kitchen on the main road.
